literal: On guawei day the imperial carriage returned from the southern campaign and announced at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: On guawei day the imperial carriage returned from the southern campaign and announced at the Grand Temple.

literal: On jiashen day salaries of idle offices were reduced to supplement army and state expenses.
idiomatic: On jiashen day salaries of idle offices were reduced to supplement army and state expenses.

literal: On yiyou day the ritual of drinking on return was performed; gifts were distributed in graded amounts.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the ritual of drinking on return was performed; gifts were distributed in graded amounts.

literal: On jiawu day the crown prince was capped at the temple.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the crown prince was capped at the temple.

literal: In the sixth month, on jihai day, an edict forbade speaking northern tribal language at court; offenders were dismissed from office.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai day, an edict forbade speaking northern tribal language at court; offenders were dismissed from office.

literal: On xinchou day an edict remitted rent and tax for three years to soldiers who had followed the imperial carriage across the Huai.
idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict remitted rent and tax for three years to soldiers who had followed the imperial carriage across the Huai.

literal: On guimao day an edict ordered the crown prince to proceed to Pingcheng palace.
idiomatic: On guimao day an edict ordered the crown prince to proceed to Pingcheng palace.

literal: On renzi day an edict to counties of Ji, Dong, Xingyang, and Henan that the imperial carriage passed through: those a hundred years and older were granted acting county magistrate, ninety and older three ranks of nobility, eighty and older two ranks, seventy and older one rank;
idiomatic: On renzi day an edict to counties of Ji, Dong, Xingyang, and Henan that the imperial carriage passed through: those a hundred years and older were granted acting county magistrate, ninety and older three ranks of nobility, eighty and older two ranks, seventy and older one rank;

literal: the solitary elderly, widowers, and orphans who could not support themselves were given grain and silk;
idiomatic: the solitary elderly, widowers, and orphans who could not support themselves were given grain and silk;

literal: those of filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and righteousness, and those with civil or military talent sought, were all to be reported by name.
idiomatic: those of filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and righteousness, and those with civil or military talent sought, were all to be reported by name.

literal: On guichou day an edict sought lost books throughout the realm; those not in the secret archive but useful to the time were to receive generous reward.
idiomatic: On guichou day an edict sought lost books throughout the realm; those not in the secret archive but useful to the time were to receive generous reward.

literal: On yimao day a partial amnesty in Liang Province; the people's field rent was remitted for three years.
idiomatic: On yimao day a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Liang province; the people's field rent was remitted for three years.

literal: On bingchen day an edict that people who had moved to Luo, on death, were buried in Henan and might not return north.
idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict ordered that people who had moved to Luo, on death, were buried in Henan and might not return north.

literal: Thereupon those of the Dai people who had moved south all became people of Henan and Luoyang.
idiomatic: Thereupon those of the Dai people who had moved south all became people of Henan and Luoyang.

literal: On wuwu day an edict changed the long foot and great bushel, following Zhou ritual institutions, and distributed them throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict changed the long foot and great bushel, following Zhou ritual institutions, and distributed them throughout the realm.

literal: In the eighth month, on jiachen day, he visited the Western Palace; on the road he saw ruined tombs with coffins exposed and halted the carriage to bury them.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiachen day, he visited the Western Palace; on the road he saw ruined tombs with coffins exposed and halted the carriage to bury them.

literal: On yisi day an edict chose a hundred and fifty thousand valiant men throughout the realm for Feathered Forest and Tiger Guard to fill the palace guard.
idiomatic: On yisi day an edict chose a hundred and fifty thousand valiant men throughout the realm for Feathered Forest and Tiger Guard to fill the palace guard.

literal: On dingsi day an edict that all soldiers wounded on campaign might return home.
idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered that all soldiers wounded on campaign might return home.

literal: Jintong palace was completed.
idiomatic: Jintong palace was completed.

literal: On jiazi day he led the officials in succession through feasts in the halls.
idiomatic: On jiazi day he led officials in succession through feasts in the halls.

literal: In the ninth month, on gengwu day, the Six Palaces and civil and military officials all moved to Luoyang.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu day, the Six Palaces and civil and military officials all moved to Luoyang.

literal: On bingxu day he traveled to Ye.
idiomatic: On bingxu day he traveled to Ye.

literal: On dinghai day an edict said: "For old tombs whose inscriptions survive and are clearly known to people of the time: the Three Dukes and those of rank equal to regional lords stay thirty paces from the tomb; Masters of Writing and the Nine Ministers fifteen paces; Yellow Gate and Five Colonels ten paces—cultivation is forbidden in each case.
idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict said, "For old tombs whose inscriptions survive and are clearly known to people of the time: the Three Dukes and those of rank equal to regional lords stay thirty paces from the tomb; masters of writing and the nine ministers fifteen paces; yellow gate and five colonels ten paces—cultivation is forbidden in each case.

literal: On renchen day a Yellow Gate gentleman was sent to sacrifice at Bi Gan's tomb with the great offering.
idiomatic: On renchen day a Yellow Gate gentleman was sent to sacrifice at Bi Gan's tomb with the great offering.

literal: On yiwei day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On yiwei day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen day, a partial amnesty in Xiang Province.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Xiang province.

literal: People a hundred years and older were given acting commandery governor; ninety and older acting county magistrate; eighty and older three ranks of nobility; seventy and older two ranks;
idiomatic: People a hundred years and older were given acting commandery governor; ninety and older acting county magistrate; eighty and older three ranks of nobility; seventy and older two ranks;

literal: the solitary elderly and chronically ill who could not support themselves were given grain and silk.
idiomatic: the solitary elderly and chronically ill who could not support themselves were given grain and silk.

literal: On bingchen day the imperial carriage returned from Ye.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the imperial carriage returned from Ye.

literal: On xinyou day an edict that in all provinces and commanderies gentry and commoners of cultivated conduct, penetrating literary thought, long talent in governance, and capacity for administration were to be sent forth in season.
idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict ordered that in all provinces and commanderies gentry and commoners of cultivated conduct, penetrating literary thought, long talent in governance, and capacity for administration were to be sent forth in season.

literal: On renxu day an edict that provincial governors examine subordinate officials, assess gain and loss, and report a three-grade scheme; the emperor would personally review and promote or demote.
idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered provincial governors to examine subordinate officials, assess gain and loss, and report a three-grade scheme; the emperor would personally review and promote or demote.

literal: An edict to Xu, Yan, Guang, Southern Qing, Jing, and Luo—the six provinces—to gather strict military readiness and muster as needed.
idiomatic: An edict to Xu, Yan, Guang, Southern Qing, Jing, and Luo—the six provinces—to gather strict military readiness and muster as needed.

literal: In the eleventh month he traveled to Weisu Mountain.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month he traveled to Weisu Mountain.

literal: The round mound altar was fixed.
idiomatic: The round mound altar was fixed.

literal: On jiashen day sacrifice was performed at the round mound.
idiomatic: On jiashen day sacrifice was performed at the round mound.

literal: On bingxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On bingxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: In the twelfth month, on yiwei day, the new moon, he summoned the officials at the Hall of Splendid Ultimate and proclaimed the rank statutes—the beginning of the great selection.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiwei day, the new moon, he summoned officials at the Hall of Splendid Ultimate and proclaimed the rank statutes—the beginning of the great selection.

literal: On xinyou day Xi, General of Agile Cavalry, Inspector of Si Province, Prince of Xianyang, was made acting Grand Commandant; Zhen, former Prince of Nan'an, had his original enfeoffment restored; Yu, special advance, Prince of Guangling, was made General Who Campaigns East, opener of government equal to the Three Excellencies, and inspector of Qing Province.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Xi, general of agile cavalry, inspector of Si province, and Prince of Xianyang, was made acting grand commandant; Zhen, former Prince of Nan'an, had his original enfeoffment restored; Yu, special advance and Prince of Guangling, was made general who campaigns east, opener of government equal to the three excellencies, and inspector of Qing province.

literal: On jiazi day he summoned the officials at the Hall of Splendid Ultimate and distributed caps and robes.
idiomatic: On jiazi day he summoned officials at the Hall of Splendid Ultimate and distributed caps and robes.

literal: In the twentieth year, spring, first month, on dingmao day, an edict changed the surname to Yuan.
idiomatic: In the twentieth year, spring, first month, on dingmao day, an edict changed the surname to Yuan.

literal: On renchen day Prince of Shiping Xie was transferred to Prince of Pengcheng; Luan, Prince of Dingxiang county, was again enfeoffed as Prince of Chengyang.
idiomatic: On renchen day Xie, Prince of Shiping, was transferred to Prince of Pengcheng; Luan, Prince of Dingxiang county, was again enfeoffed as Prince of Chengyang.

literal: In the second month, on xinchou day, the emperor visited Hualin and heard cases at the capital tribunal.
idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou day, the emperor visited Hualin and heard cases at the capital tribunal.

literal: On renyin day an edict that except in wartime, three years' mourning might be completed.
idiomatic: On renyin day an edict ordered that except in wartime, three years' mourning might be completed.

literal: On bingwu day an edict that within the capital circuit those seventy and older were to come to the capital at late spring for the rite of nurturing the aged.
idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict ordered that within the capital circuit those seventy and older were to come to the capital at late spring for the rite of nurturing the aged.

literal: On gengxu day he visited Hualin and heard cases at the capital tribunal.
idiomatic: On gengxu day he visited Hualin and heard cases at the capital tribunal.

literal: On guichou day an edict that in Jieshan district alone Cold Food Festival was permitted; elsewhere it was forbidden.
idiomatic: On guichou day an edict permitted Cold Food Festival in Jieshan district alone; elsewhere it was forbidden.

literal: In the third month, on bingyin day, he feasted officials, state elders, and common elders in Hualin Garden.
idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin day, he feasted officials, state elders, and common elders in Hualin Garden.

literal: An edict said: "State elders of yellow hoary age and above receive acting Palace Gentleman of the Scattered Cavalry and commandery governor;
idiomatic: An edict said, "State elders of yellow hoary age and above receive acting palace gentleman of the scattered cavalry and commandery governor;

literal: those of venerable age and above receive acting Supernumerary Attendant and county magistrate;
idiomatic: those of venerable age and above receive acting supernumerary attendant and county magistrate;

literal: common elders receive direct acting county or commandery posts.
idiomatic: common elders receive direct acting county or commandery posts.

literal: Each was given a dove staff and garments.
idiomatic: Each was given a dove staff and garments.

literal: " On dingchou day an edict that provincial rectifiers in each province recommend men of local repute fifty and older of plain living and closed gates, to be appointed magistrates.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered provincial rectifiers in each province to recommend men of local repute fifty and older of plain living and closed gates, to be appointed magistrates.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen day, Inspector of Guang Province Xue Fahu rebelled south.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen day, Xue Fahu, inspector of Guang province, rebelled south.

literal: In the fifth month, on bingzi day, an edict said: "Agriculture is the head of government, millet the people's first need; timely rain in abundance is what should be earnestly encouraged.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingzi day, an edict said, "Agriculture is the head of government, millet the people's first need; timely rain in abundance is what should be earnestly encouraged.

literal: Let the capital circuit strictly supervise levies; the idle are to be punished with the rod, and the diligent in fields are all to be reported by name."
idiomatic: Let the capital circuit strictly supervise levies; the idle are to be punished with the rod, and the diligent in fields are all to be reported by name."

literal: On bingxu day the square mound altar at Heyin was first built.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the square mound altar at Heyin was first built.

literal: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tombs of Han Guangwu and the Ming and Zhang emperors with the great offering.
idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tombs of Han Guangwu and the Ming and Zhang emperors with the great offering.

literal: Further, an edict that tombs of emperors of Han, Wei, and Jin each had a hundred paces forbidden to fuel-gathering and trampling.
idiomatic: Further, an edict ordered that tombs of emperors of Han, Wei, and Jin each had a hundred paces forbidden to fuel-gathering and trampling.

literal: On dinghai day the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the square mound.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the square mound.

literal: In the seventh month Empress Feng was deposed.
idiomatic: In the seventh month Empress Feng was deposed.

literal: On wuyin day, because of long drought, the emperor performed ranked sacrifice to the spirits;
idiomatic: On wuyin day, because of long drought, the emperor performed ranked sacrifice to the spirits;

literal: from guiwei he ate nothing until yiyou; that night timely rain fell in abundance.
idiomatic: from guiwei he ate nothing until yiyou; that night timely rain fell in abundance.

literal: On dinghai day an edict said: "Blazing sun and clear season, autumn showers gathered—Our responsibility is deep dread; therefore We stopped meals for three mornings to appeal above.
idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict said, "Blazing sun and clear season, autumn showers gathered—my responsibility is deep dread; therefore I stopped meals for three mornings to appeal above.

literal: The numinous mirror saw sincerity; clouds and rain bent in streams.
idiomatic: The numinous mirror saw sincerity; clouds and rain bent in streams.

literal: Though rest is commanded, We dare not slacken.
idiomatic: Though rest is commanded, I dare not slacken.

literal: Perhaps worthy men lie hidden in virtue and lofty scholars dwell in seclusion—though selection is increased, they have not yet been summoned.
idiomatic: Perhaps worthy men lie hidden in virtue and lofty scholars dwell in seclusion—though selection is increased, they have not yet been summoned.

literal: Let hidden valleys be searched thoroughly and worthy men raised; speak blunt counsel and correct Our shortcomings.
idiomatic: Let hidden valleys be searched thoroughly and worthy men raised; speak blunt counsel and correct my shortcomings.

literal: Further, flatterers who ruin the court are truly worms in governance;
idiomatic: Further, flatterers who ruin the court are truly worms in governance;

literal: greedy men who steal posts greatly impair great policy.
idiomatic: greedy men who steal posts greatly impair great policy.

literal: Those in charge are to impeach the unworthy and clearly demote thieves of salary.
idiomatic: Those in charge are to impeach the unworthy and clearly demote thieves of salary.

literal: Further, law is the pivot of governance and the people's lives especially weighty—prisoners in the capital are all to memorialize in detail; We will personally review and decide in season.
idiomatic: Further, law is the pivot of governance and the people's lives especially weighty—prisoners in the capital are all to memorialize in detail; I will personally review and decide in season.

literal: Further, the six extremes of suffering are what men and spirits pity—timely inquiry and relief should rescue the destitute.
idiomatic: Further, the six extremes of suffering are what men and spirits pity—timely inquiry and relief should rescue the destitute.

literal: Widowers, orphans, and the impoverished who cannot support themselves are clearly to receive compassionate relief so they may survive.
idiomatic: Widowers, orphans, and the impoverished who cannot support themselves are clearly to receive compassionate relief so they may survive.

literal: Further, light corvée and low tax are the ruler's constant reason—annual regular labor is all to be reported in detail.
idiomatic: Further, light corvée and low tax are the ruler's constant reason—annual regular labor is all to be reported in detail.

literal: Further, the way of husband and wife is what the people put first; mid-spring pairing has ritual precedent—men and women past season are to be joined by ritual.
idiomatic: Further, the way of husband and wife is what the people put first; mid-spring pairing has ritual precedent—men and women past season are to be joined by ritual.

literal: Further, capital people newly at work take farming and sericulture as root—how much field grain, whether levies were supervised or not, [9] report all in detail."
idiomatic: Further, capital people newly at work take farming and sericulture as root—how much field grain, whether levies were supervised or not, [9] report all in detail."

literal: In the eighth month, on renchen day, the new moon, he visited Hualin Garden, personally reviewed prisoners, and all were sent off with two grades reduced from the original offense.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen day, the new moon, he visited Hualin Garden, personally reviewed prisoners, and all were sent off with two grades reduced from the original offense.

literal: On wuxu day the imperial carriage visited Song Mountain.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the imperial carriage visited Song Mountain.

literal: On jiayin day he returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On jiayin day he returned to the palace.

literal: On dingsi day Prince of Nan'an Zhen died.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Zhen, Prince of Nan'an, died.

literal: He visited Hualin Garden to hear cases.
idiomatic: He visited Hualin Garden to hear cases.

literal: In the ninth month, on wuchen day, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Xiaoping Ford.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuchen day, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Xiaoping Ford.

literal: On guiyou day he returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On guiyou day he returned to the palace.

literal: On dinghai day the Luo River was to be connected into the Gu; the emperor personally watched.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the Luo River was to be connected into the Gu; the emperor personally watched.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu day, all soldiers who had moved from Dai were made Feathered Forest and Tiger Guard;
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu day, all soldiers who had moved from Dai were made Feathered Forest and Tiger Guard;

literal: people of Si Province—twelve households supplied one clerk as rotating soldier for four years, with annual rotation leave to supply public and private labor.
idiomatic: people of Si province—twelve households supplied one clerk as rotating soldier for four years, with annual rotation leave to supply public and private labor.

literal: On jiyou day a partial amnesty in the capital.
idiomatic: On jiyou day a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

literal: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, Jinghe, grandson of the former Prince of Runan Tianci, was again enfeoffed as Prince of Runan; Taixing, former Prince of Jingzhao, as Prince of Xihe.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, Jinghe, grandson of the former Prince of Runan Tianci, was again enfeoffed as Prince of Runan; Taixing, former Prince of Jingzhao, as Prince of Xihe.

literal: In the intercalary month, on bingchen day, Right General Yuan Long greatly defeated rebel Hu of Fen Province.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingchen day, Yuan Long, right general, greatly defeated rebel Hu of Fen province.

literal: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, because northwest commanderies and counties suffered drought and famine, [10] attendant ministers were sent to inspect, open granaries, and relieve.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, because northwest commanderies and counties suffered drought and famine, [10] attendant ministers were sent to inspect, open granaries, and relieve.

literal: On yichou day the prohibition on salt pools was opened and shared with the people.
idiomatic: On yichou day the prohibition on salt pools was opened and shared with the people.

literal: On bingyin day Crown Prince Xu was deposed as commoner;
idiomatic: On bingyin day Crown Prince Xu was deposed as commoner;

literal: On dingmao day the Grand Temple was notified.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the Grand Temple was notified.

literal: On wuchen day the Ever-Normal Granary was established.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the Ever-Normal Granary was established.

literal: Inspector of Heng Province Mu Tai and others plotted rebellion in the province; Acting Minister of Personnel, Prince of Rencheng Cheng was sent to investigate.
idiomatic: Mu Tai, inspector of Heng province, and others plotted rebellion in the province; Cheng, acting minister of personnel and Prince of Rencheng, was sent to investigate.

literal: Siyu, Prince of Leling, was punished for knowing Tai's plot and not reporting—his nobility was stripped and he was made a commoner.
idiomatic: Siyu, Prince of Leling, was punished for knowing Tai's plot and not reporting—his nobility was stripped and he was made a commoner.

literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on bingshen day, Prince Ke was installed as crown prince; those throughout the realm who had adopted heirs were granted one rank of nobility.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on bingshen day, Prince Ke was installed as crown prince; those throughout the realm who had adopted heirs were granted one rank of nobility.

literal: On jihai day Acting Attendant-in-Ordinary Zhang Yi and Cui Guang, and Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Liu Zao, were sent to tour the regions, inspect, inquire into the people's hardships, promote and demote prefects and magistrates, and proclaim transforming influence.
idiomatic: On jihai day Zhang Yi and Cui Guang, acting attendants-in-ordinary, and Liu Zao, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, were sent to tour the regions, inspect, inquire into the people's hardships, promote and demote prefects and magistrates, and proclaim transforming influence.

literal: On yisi day the imperial carriage toured north.
idiomatic: On yisi day the imperial carriage toured north.

literal: In the second month, on renxu day, he halted at Taiyuan.
idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu day, he halted at Taiyuan.
